turns.said: VAT yange ntya okugisasula, era ebitundu bimeka?
assistant:
Okumanya ssente z'osasula ku musolo ogw'okukozesa mu maaso, nkusaba okutegeera ekika ky'emmotoka yo nga weesigama ku mateeka gano wammanga:
Emmotoka ezitwala abasaabaze (PSVs) ne bbaasi: Ojja kusasula shilingi twenty thousand buli kifo ky’omusaabaze.
Tirakita: Ojja kusasula shilingi fifty thousand buli tani y’obusobozi bw’okutikka. - Emmotoka ezitwala ebintu ezisukka ku bbiri tani: Ojja kusasula shilingi fifty thousand buli tani y’obusobozi bw’okutikka. Ku bikwata ku kigero ky’obusente ekirina okusasulwa nga oteekateeka okuwakanya mu Kkooti y’Obusolo bw’Omusolo (Tax Appeals Tribunal – Tax Appeals Tribunal), olina kusasula ebitundu amakumi asatu ku buli kikumi ku musolo ogwasaliddwa oba ekitundu ky’omusolo ekitali mu nsonga, ekisinga obunene. Oyagala okumanya ebisingawo?
caller: Vati yanga entya okugisasula era ebitundu bimeeka.
Kati yange ntya okugisasula era ebitundu bimeeka?

turns.said: Njagala okwogera n'omuntu, omukozi wa URA.
assistant:
Okusinziira ku bubaka obuweereddwa, wano waliwo okusasula omusolo ogw'omu maaso nga bwe kuli mu bibinja by'emmotoka:
Emmotoka ezitambuza abasaabaze (PSVs) n’Obusolo: shilingi twenty thousand buli kifo ky’omusaabaze buli mwaka. - Obutimba bw’emigugu: shilingi fifty thousand buli tani buli mwaka. - Emmotoka z’ebyamaguzi/ebintu ebisukka ku bbiri tani: shilingi fifty thousand buli tani buli mwaka. Oyagala okumanya ebisingawo?
caller: Njye dara okwu ogera n'omu nto nkozwa URA.
